summary: Capitol Federal Financial, Inc. filed an 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 disclosing a press release announcing its annual stockholders meeting date. The meeting is set for Tuesday, January 26, 2027, with a voting record date of December 4, 2026. No board recommendation on a transaction, advisor, or structural mechanics are disclosed. This is a routine meeting notice, the US equivalent of an AGM scheduling announcement, not a special situation. No deal terms, stake, price, or premium apply; no risk-arb angle exists.
